topic: Connecting to the development ClickHouse cluster
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on connecting and interacting with the development ClickHouse cluster. It was noted that nodes are accessible directly (e.g., clickhouse01-dev.allunite.local, clickhouse02-dev.allunite.local). The plan is to attempt data insertion into these nodes.
decisions: Attempting direct connection and data insertion into the dev ClickHouse cluster.
